facts.text: The Beaumont Mayfair is an Art Deco modernist hotel with a boutique attitude in central London.
facts.excerpt: The Beaumont Mayfair pulls off a rare feat of being an Art Deco modernist hotel with a boutique attitude, brimming with the vibrant charm of its central London neighbourhood.

facts.text: The bedroom of the ROOM suite occupies the interior of a giant semi-abstract sculpture by Sir Antony Gormley on the hotel's entrance front on Brown Hart Gardens.
facts.excerpt: The bedroom of this unique suite occupies the interior of a giant semi-abstract sculpture by Sir Antony Gormley, which dominates the entrance front of The Beaumont Mayfair on Brown Hart Gardens.

facts.text: ROOM's dark oak-clad bedroom is approached up nine white marble steps and separated by a black velvet curtain from a white marble bathroom.
facts.excerpt: The interior, which forms the dark oak-clad bedroom of a one-bedroom suite, is approached up nine white marble steps, separated by a black velvet curtain from a pure white marble bathroom.

facts.text: ROOM's stainless steel exterior represents a giant crouching cuboid figure based on the artist's body.
facts.excerpt: It makes a striking juxtaposition to the stainless steel exterior, which represents a giant crouching cuboid figure based on the artist's body.

facts.text: Each room has a unique selection of original prints, books and paintings.
facts.excerpt: Each room is tailored for individuality, with a unique selection of original prints, books and paintings.

facts.text: Premier Rooms use bronze mirrors, mohair velvets and silks reflecting an Art Deco aesthetic.
facts.excerpt: Bronze mirrors, mohair velvets and sumptuous silks reflect a sophisticated Art Deco aesthetic.

facts.text: Mayfair Suites are the largest one-bedroom suites, and most overlook Brown Hart Gardens or the rooftops of Mayfair.
facts.excerpt: these are the largest of our one-bedroom suites. Each has its own unique layout, most overlook Brown Hart Gardens or the rooftops of Mayfair.

facts.text: Each Mayfair Suite features a library of specially selected reading material.
facts.excerpt: Each features an extensive library of specially selected reading material.

facts.text: The Premier Junior Suite with Terrace has a separate dressing area and a private outdoor terrace.
facts.excerpt: features unique elements such as a separate dressing area and a private outdoor terrace.

facts.text: The Roosevelt Suite is available as a one-bedroom or a five-bedroom suite.
facts.excerpt: The Roosevelt Suite is available as a one-bedroom (169m²) or a five-bedroom (606m²) suite.

facts.text: The Junior Suite Wing groups a Deluxe Junior Suite, a Premier Junior Suite and a Superior Grand Room in a separate corridor for families or larger groups.
facts.excerpt: For families or larger groups, The Junior Suite Wing provides an exclusive residential-style experience. This private enclave includes a Deluxe Junior Suite, a Premier Junior Suite, and a Superior Grand Room, all set within a discreet, separate corridor

facts.text: The Spa & Hammam offers treatments seven days a week.
facts.excerpt: The Beaumont's Spa & Hammam offers a range  of treatments seven days a week.

facts.text: The hotel's restaurant is Rosi, and Le Magritte is the hotel bar serving classic cocktails.
facts.excerpt: The Beaumont Mayfair's glamorous restaurant Rosi is making waves, while Le Magritte, a timeless Mayfair hotel bar, serves classic cocktails and stylish snacks.

facts.text: The Gatsby Room serves afternoon tea and a wide range of Champagnes.
facts.excerpt: The Gatsby Room is a relaxed, intimate perfect spot to enjoy afternoon tea and a wide range of Champagnes.

facts.text: Some Superior and Superior Grand rooms are fully accessible for guests with reduced mobility.
facts.excerpt: Some Superior Grand rooms are designed to be fully accessible for guests with reduced mobility.

facts.text: Superior Grand Rooms overlook Brown Hart Gardens and can interconnect for families travelling with children.
facts.excerpt: Perfect for those looking for extra space or travelling with children, these expansive rooms can interconnect to provide even more space.

facts.text: The hotel offers dog-friendly stays.
